subject: general
question: Which of the following is a non-perennial river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Krishna.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Non-perennial rivers**

__
 
• Non-perennial rivers are rivers in which** flow of water is seasonal and not for the whole year.**
 
• These rivers do not receive water during the **whole year except during rainy season through water cycle**.
 
• Examples of these rivers are **Godavari, Krishna, etc.**
 
• These rivers also **do not originate from glacial areas like Himalayan rivers do.**
 
• These rivers may **cause flood due to heavy rainfall.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Perennial rivers**
 
• Perennial rivers are rivers** having continuous flow throughout the year.**
 
• Perennial rivers **have a continuous reliable sources**.
 
• Examples of perennial rivers are **Ganges, Yamuna, Indus, Brahmaputra, Sindhu, etc.**
 
• **Ganges**
 
 
• **It is the longest flowing river.**
 
• **Origin: Gangotri**
 
• **Length:2510km **
 
 
 
• **Brahmaputra**
 
 
• **The transboundary river flows through Tibet, India and Bangladesh.**
 
• **Origin: Himalayas**
 
• **Length: 2900km**
